claim_text: 來源機構：교육부（韓國教育部）；資料標題：아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 학교 경영자, 함께 모여 인공지능 기반 교육 혁신의 길을 찾다；來源刊登日：2026-10-20。官方文件表示：韓國教育部將於 10 月 21 日至 23 日在首爾舉辦「2026 年 APEC 學校領導力計畫」研習，對象為 APEC 會員經濟體中小學校長與副校長，主題為「人工智慧時代，引領與世界連結之學校的創新領導力」，著重分享可在學校現場運用的人工智慧教育創新案例；52 名學校經營者參加，將參訪首爾女子中學與首爾教育科技 Soft Lab，分組分享各國學校創新案例。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

claim_text: 來源機構：Journal of Research on Technology in Education (Taylor & Francis)；資料標題：Critical Fairness Literacy for PK–12 teachers: a fairness-specific dimension of teacher AI competency；來源刊登日：2026-10-20。作者摘要報告：本概念性論文透過結構化文獻綜整（教師AI能力、批判性AI素養、演算法公平、教育AI倫理與教育公平），提出「批判性公平素養」（CFL）作為教師AI能力中聚焦公平的子面向，包含辨識偏誤來源、情境化教育公平分析與檢視公平定義，並提出偏誤追溯、以教育公平為中心的情境審查與公平框架反思三項實務程序，連結課堂判斷與專業學習；作者指出其仍屬理論性提案，需實證檢驗。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

original_excerpt: This conceptual paper develops Critical Fairness Literacy (CFL) through a structured synthesis of literature on teacher AI competency, critical AI literacy, algorithmic fairness, educational AI ethics, and educational equity. … CFL is proposed as a subdimension of teacher AI competency focused on fairness, comprising bias source identification, contextual equity analysis, and interrogation of fairness definitions. … Three practical protocols, bias tracing, equity-centered contextual review, and fairness framing reflection, connect these dimensions to classroom judgment and professional learning. … The framework and protocols remain theoretically informed proposals requiring empirical investigation.

summary_evidence_spans: This conceptual paper develops Critical Fairness Literacy (CFL) through a structured synthesis of literature on teacher AI competency, critical AI literacy, algorithmic fairness, educational AI ethics, and educational equity.
CFL is proposed as a subdimension of teacher AI competency focused on fairness, comprising bias source identification, contextual equity analysis, and interrogation of fairness definitions.
Three practical protocols, bias tracing, equity-centered contextual review, and fairness framing reflection, connect these dimensions to classroom judgment and professional learning.
The framework and protocols remain theoretically informed proposals requiring empirical investigation.
